label: Restart
intent: The device restarts. Light: the power bar drops down into the ring, switching off; the ring with its arrow turns one full turn clockwise, and as its gap comes back round to the top the bar shoots back up into it, switching on with a hit and a small rebound. Strong: the ring winds back first, spins past the top and settles back, and the bar slams up and rebounds twice.

ring.//: the set's power ring: a gap of 84 degrees at the top

head.//: the arrowhead at the ring's top-left end, pointing on round the turn (clockwise)

motion.//: +5 is the power icon's off pose: the bar sunk into the ring, clear of the ring as it turns.
